summary: News sweep of the Federal Register issue of 2026-10-30, the Supreme Court order lists and the White House presidential actions page, plus a rotation of six freshness checks and four refutation checks and four watch items. No stage changed. A 2026-10-28 Section 232 proclamation on robotics and industrial machinery, which directs negotiations and sets no duty, was added to c26-04 (diverged); the 2026-10-23 Canada Section 338 proclamation was published as Proclamation 11076 (91 FR 68861) and its operative text read in full for c26-01. Freshness evidence or corrections were added to c02-02, c10-03, c13-09 and c12-25, and the refutation checks on c00-11, c14-09, c26-03 and c15-01 held. Eight changed records were independently reviewed. Counted totals are unchanged.
